newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norsk Hydro completes Oseberg, Brage maintenance.
newsitem.headline: Norsk Hydro completes Oseberg, Brage maintenance.

text.p: Norsk Hydro ASA said on Monday it was preparing to restart the Oseberg Field Centre oil platform following an eight-day scheduled stoppage for maintenance.

Oseberg Field Centre was shut in June 8, together with Oseberg C, Oseberg West and the Brage developments. Oseberg C was brought back onstream on Sunday night, while Brage was due to resume pumping on Monday night, a spokesman for the company said.
In May, combined output from Oseberg Field Centre and Oseberg West was 346,611 barrels per day (bpd), while Oseberg C produced 148,576 bpd and Brage 104,939 bpd.
